name: Kibookal Sacred Manuscript Infographic Mythology
zip_source: current user references + 04 visual system docs
composition: A complete myth on one ornate parchment page; central deity/hero/being; side panels and bottom strip; floral borders; peacocks/birds; internal story panels inside robes/body; readable sacred hierarchy.
visual_traits: large serif-like headings if text_mode allows
prompt_core: Create a Kibookal sacred manuscript infographic mythology plate of [SUBJECT]. The page feels like an ancient-future Indian children’s sacred archive: cream parchment, floral borders, birds, lotus motifs, ritual symbols, archive cards and tiny diagram panels. Place the subject front-facing or dignified, with calm intelligent eyes, strong halo and body/clothing containing the full story universe: [STORY_SEED]. Use flat mineral colours, dark brown-black ink contours, controlled hatching, ornate but readable linework, and child-intelligent mystery. If text_mode is none, remove all writing and keep only decorative blank panels, icons and symbolic marks.
negative: no generic myth poster, no AI fantasy glow, no photorealism, no clutter on face, no inaccurate random text, no copying reference layout exactly
render_directive: Render the requested SUBJECT / CHARACTER fully in THIS exact style. Keep the subject's identity, key features and intended action recognizable, but the medium, palette, linework, texture, composition and finish are 100% this style. ANY character, deity, creature, person, animal or object can be rendered in this style — adapt the subject INTO the style; never bend the style toward the subject.
